note: Diablo III cosmetic table (wings, pets, pennants, portrait frames) in the order of the account save bitfield (SavedDefinition.account_wide_cosmetic_item_data): index = bit. gbid = hash of the internal name (h = h*33 + c over the lowercase name, int32). Read from CUSA00242/CUSA00243 1.47 at run time (tools/d3save.py, HANDOFF).
transmog_note: Transmog appearances (legendary and set items): one bit per entry of the game's 1076-entry transmog table, in each partition's crafter_data.transmog_data. "valid" marks the 764 the game keeps when it loads a save with every bit set (it drops legacy item versions, placeholders and tests).
